## A {#a}

### Acceleration {#acceleration}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-acceleration"}

**Plain Language:** The rate at which an object's speed or direction changes over time.

**Technical Definition:** The second time derivative of position in a declared reference frame, a = d^2r/dt^2.

**Symbols / Notation:** $a$, $\ddot{r}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Aerodynamic Drag {#aerodynamic-drag}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-aerodynamic-drag"}

**Plain Language:** The air resistance pushing backwards against the ball or club during flight.

**Technical Definition:** The fluid resistance force opposing relative velocity, F_D = 0.5 * rho * v^2 * C_D * A.

**Symbols / Notation:** $F_D$, $C_D$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Aerodynamic Lift {#aerodynamic-lift}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-aerodynamic-lift"}

**Plain Language:** The upward aerodynamic force generated as backspin interacts with airflow.

**Technical Definition:** The component of aerodynamic force perpendicular to the oncoming flow direction, F_L = 0.5 * rho * v^2 * C_L * A.

**Symbols / Notation:** $F_L$, $C_L$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Affine Control System {#affine-control-system}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-affine-control-system"}

**Plain Language:** A physical system where motion is the sum of natural coasting plus active motor effort.

**Technical Definition:** A dynamical system of the form dx/dt = f(x) + G(x)u, affine in the input vector u with drift vector field f(x) and control matrix G(x).

**Symbols / Notation:** $\dot{x} = f(x) + G(x)u$, $f(x)$, $G(x)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Affine Decomposition {#affine-decomposition}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-affine-decomposition"}

**Plain Language:** Separating a moving system's motion into unforced natural drift and the part caused by active controls.

**Technical Definition:** The partition of the total generalized acceleration or tangent vector into an unforced zero-input component and an actuator-dependent linear map.

**Symbols / Notation:** $f(x)$, $G(x)u$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Angular Acceleration {#angular-acceleration}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-angular-acceleration"}

**Plain Language:** The rate at which rotational spin speed or rotation axis changes over time.

**Technical Definition:** The time derivative of angular velocity vector in a declared reference frame, alpha = d(omega)/dt.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\alpha$, $\dot{\omega}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/rotation-representations-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Angular Momentum {#angular-momentum}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-angular-momentum"}

**Plain Language:** The rotational momentum of a spinning or revolving object, resisting changes to its spin.

**Technical Definition:** The cross product of position and linear momentum, or the product of inertia tensor and angular velocity, L = I * omega.

**Symbols / Notation:** $L$, $H$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Angular Velocity {#angular-velocity}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-angular-velocity"}

**Plain Language:** How quickly an object rotates around an axis and the direction of that axis.

**Technical Definition:** The axial vector omega describing the instantaneous rate and axis of rotation of a rigid body.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\omega$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/rotation-representations-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## B {#b}

### Backswing {#backswing}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-backswing"}

**Plain Language:** The preparatory movement moving the club away from the ball to the top of the swing.

**Technical Definition:** The phase taking the multibody system from static address to transition, setting initial kinematic and elastic conditions for the downswing.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/theory-part1.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Ball Compression {#ball-compression}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-ball-compression"}

**Plain Language:** The amount a golf ball squashes during an impact test under a standardized load.

**Technical Definition:** An empirical index measuring deflection under a standard load, distinct from dynamic restitution or material Young's modulus.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## C {#c}

### Center of Mass {#center-of-mass}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-center-of-mass"}

**Plain Language:** The average position of all the weight in a body or club.

**Technical Definition:** The unique point r_com = (1/M) * sum(m_i * r_i) where the weighted relative position of distributed mass sums to zero.

**Symbols / Notation:** $r_{com}$, $COM$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Center of Pressure {#center-of-pressure}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-center-of-pressure"}

**Plain Language:** The point on the ground where the total pushing force under the feet is centered.

**Technical Definition:** The spatial centroid of the ground normal pressure distribution, r_cop = integral(r * p(r) dA) / integral(p(r) dA).

**Symbols / Notation:** $COP$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/technology-force-measurement.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Clubhead Speed {#clubhead-speed}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-clubhead-speed"}

**Plain Language:** The linear speed of the center of the clubface immediately before impact.

**Technical Definition:** The magnitude of the instantaneous linear velocity vector of the clubhead center of mass immediately prior to collision, v_c = ||v_{head}(t_{impact}^-)||.

**Symbols / Notation:** $v_c$, $v_{head}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Coefficient of Restitution {#coefficient-of-restitution}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-coefficient-of-restitution"}

**Plain Language:** The bounciness of a collision, measuring how much speed remains after impact.

**Technical Definition:** The ratio of relative separation speed to relative approach speed along the collision normal, e = -(v_b^+ - v_c^+) / (v_b^- - v_c^-).

**Symbols / Notation:** $e$, $COR$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Constraint Force {#constraint-force}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-constraint-force"}

**Plain Language:** Forces inside joints or at ground contact that hold bodies together without performing work along free directions.

**Technical Definition:** The Lagrange multiplier reaction forces lambda acting normal to the admissible configuration manifold, satisfying J^T lambda with J * q_dot = 0.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\lambda$, $J^T \lambda$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/null-space-constraint-jacobian.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Control Authority {#control-authority}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-control-authority"}

**Plain Language:** The maximum ability of muscles or actuators to change the system's acceleration.

**Technical Definition:** The range of the input mapping G(x) applied to the admissible control set U, measuring achievable control-induced accelerations.

**Symbols / Notation:** $G(x)U$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Control Input {#control-input}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-control-input"}

**Plain Language:** The active muscle forces or motor commands supplied by the golfer.

**Technical Definition:** The vector of generalized forces or joint torques u(t) within the admissible torque bounds U.

**Symbols / Notation:** $u(t)$, $\tau$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Cost Function {#cost-function}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-cost-function"}

**Plain Language:** A mathematical score measuring what an optimization algorithm tries to minimize (like effort or error).

**Technical Definition:** A functional J(x, u) quantifying trajectory error, effort expenditure, or terminal clubhead velocity in optimal control problems.

**Symbols / Notation:** $J$, $\mathcal{L}(x, u)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/nonlinear-control-insights.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## D {#d}

### Degrees of Freedom {#degrees-of-freedom}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-degrees-of-freedom"}

**Plain Language:** The number of independent directions in which a system can move.

**Technical Definition:** The dimension of the configuration manifold, n = d * N - k, where N is the number of bodies and k is the number of holonomic constraints.

**Symbols / Notation:** $DoF$, $n$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/degrees-of-freedom-and-dimensionality.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Double Pendulum {#double-pendulum}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-double-pendulum"}

**Plain Language:** A classic two-segment mechanical model representing the arms and the golf club.

**Technical Definition:** A planar or spatial multibody system with two rigid links connected by revolute or universal joints, often modeling torso/arms and club.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/drift-components-wrench-double-pendulum.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Downswing {#downswing}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-downswing"}

**Plain Language:** The rapid motion from the top of the swing down to the ball.

**Technical Definition:** The forward acceleration phase between transition and impact where potential and kinetic energy are converted and directed into the clubhead.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/theory-part1.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Drift {#drift}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-drift"}

**Plain Language:** The natural motion the club or body continues along under inertia, gravity, and passive forces without active muscles.

**Technical Definition:** The unforced vector field f(x) in an affine control system dx/dt = f(x) + G(x)u, capturing inertia, Coriolis, centrifugal, gravity, and passive stiffness.

**Symbols / Notation:** $f(x)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Drift-Control Ratio (DCR) {#drift-control-ratio}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-drift-control-ratio"}

**Plain Language:** The proportion of swing motion driven by natural momentum compared to active muscle effort.

**Technical Definition:** The capacity-normalized ratio of unforced drift acceleration to total acceleration capacity, ranging from 0 (pure control) to 1 (pure drift).

**Symbols / Notation:** $DCR$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/drift-control-ratio.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Dynamic Coupling {#dynamic-coupling}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-dynamic-coupling"}

**Plain Language:** The physical phenomenon where applying torque to one joint automatically accelerates other joints.

**Technical Definition:** The off-diagonal terms in the multibody mass matrix M(q) causing cross-joint acceleration via \ddot{q} = M(q)^{-1}(u - C(q, \dot{q})\dot{q} - G(q)).

**Symbols / Notation:** $M(q)^{-1}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/force-mobility-matrices.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## E {#e}

### Equations of Motion {#equations-of-motion}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-equations-of-motion"}

**Plain Language:** The mathematical formulas describing how the body and club accelerate given current positions, speeds, and forces.

**Technical Definition:** The second-order differential equations M(q)\ddot{q} + C(q, \dot{q})\dot{q} + G(q) = u + J^T \lambda derived from Lagrangian mechanics.

**Symbols / Notation:** $M(q)\ddot{q} + C(q,\dot{q})\dot{q} + G(q) = \tau$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Extension {#extension}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-extension"}

**Plain Language:** Straightening a joint or bending backwards.

**Technical Definition:** Movement in the sagittal plane increasing the angle between articulating skeletal segments.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/theory-part2.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## F {#f}

### Fail-Closed {#fail-closed}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-fail-closed"}

**Plain Language:** A safety rule where a check stops and refuses to pass if it cannot verify complete evidence.

**Technical Definition:** A validation policy that treats indeterminate, missing, or corrupt records as failing rather than defaulting to permissive execution.

[Read in Context &rarr;](overview.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Feedback Control {#feedback-control}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-feedback-control"}

**Plain Language:** Adjusting muscle effort based on sensory observations during movement.

**Technical Definition:** A control policy u(x(t), t) where actuation is dynamically updated based on measured state error relative to a desired trajectory.

**Symbols / Notation:** $u(x)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/nonlinear-control-insights.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Feedforward Control {#feedforward-control}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-feedforward-control"}

**Plain Language:** Pre-planned muscle commands executed without waiting for sensory feedback.

**Technical Definition:** An open-loop control trajectory u(t) synthesized prior to movement initiation based on an internal forward model of the system.

**Symbols / Notation:** $u(t)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/ideomotor-theory-and-predictive-brain.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Flexion {#flexion}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-flexion"}

**Plain Language:** Bending a joint to decrease the angle between body segments.

**Technical Definition:** Movement in the sagittal plane decreasing the angle between articulating bones.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/theory-part2.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Forward Dynamics {#forward-dynamics}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-forward-dynamics"}

**Plain Language:** Calculating how the golfer and club will move given the applied muscle torques.

**Technical Definition:** Solving the equations of motion for state accelerations \ddot{q} given generalized coordinates q, velocities \dot{q}, and input torques u.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\ddot{q} = f(q, \dot{q}, u)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## G {#g}

### Generalized Coordinates {#generalized-coordinates}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-generalized-coordinates"}

**Plain Language:** The smallest set of numbers needed to describe the exact position and angles of the body and club.

**Technical Definition:** A minimal set of independent parameters q = (q_1, ..., q_n) uniquely specifying the system configuration on its constraint manifold.

**Symbols / Notation:** $q$, $q_i$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Generalized Forces {#generalized-forces}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-generalized-forces"}

**Plain Language:** The effective forces or torques acting directly along the generalized coordinates.

**Technical Definition:** The virtual work coefficients Q_i = sum(F_j * dr_j / dq_i) conjugate to generalized coordinates q_i.

**Symbols / Notation:** $Q_i$, $\tau$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Governed {#governed}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-governed"}

**Plain Language:** Tracked by the publication's scientific review and claim-audit process.

**Technical Definition:** Subject to explicit falsification ledgers, verifiable provenance, and continuous regression testing in the scientific claim registry.

[Read in Context &rarr;](overview.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Ground Reaction Force (GRF) {#ground-reaction-force}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-ground-reaction-force"}

**Plain Language:** The contact force exerted by the ground back against the golfer's shoes.

**Technical Definition:** The equal and opposite reaction force vector F_grf exerted by the ground on the feet according to Newton's third law.

**Symbols / Notation:** $F_{grf}$, $GRF$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/technology-force-measurement.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## I {#i}

### Ideomotor Theory {#ideomotor-theory}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-ideomotor-theory"}

**Plain Language:** The concept that movements are planned and triggered by anticipating their sensory outcomes.

**Technical Definition:** The psychological and neurocomputational framework asserting that actions are represented, selected, and controlled by anticipated perceptual effects.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/ideomotor-theory-and-predictive-brain.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Impact {#impact}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-impact"}

**Plain Language:** The collision between clubhead and ball lasting under half a millisecond.

**Technical Definition:** A brief collision (~400 microseconds) characterized by large contact forces (~10 kN) transferring momentum and kinetic energy.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\Delta t_{impact}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Induced Acceleration {#induced-acceleration}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-induced-acceleration"}

**Plain Language:** The acceleration of any segment caused indirectly by a force applied elsewhere in the body.

**Technical Definition:** The contribution to \ddot{q} from an individual joint torque or force component through the inverse mass matrix M(q)^{-1}.

**Symbols / Notation:** $M(q)^{-1}\tau_k$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/superposition.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Inverse Dynamics {#inverse-dynamics}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-inverse-dynamics"}

**Plain Language:** Working backward from measured motion to estimate the net forces and torques at joints.

**Technical Definition:** Computing net joint torques u(t) by substituting measured positions q(t), velocities \dot{q}(t), and accelerations \ddot{q}(t) into the equations of motion.

**Symbols / Notation:** $u = M(q)\ddot{q} + C(q, \dot{q})\dot{q} + G(q)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/inverse-dynamics.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## K {#k}

### Kinetic Chain {#kinetic-chain}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-kinetic-chain"}

**Plain Language:** The linked series of connected body segments passing motion from the feet to the hands.

**Technical Definition:** An open or closed kinematic chain of articulated rigid bodies transferring momentum, work, and constraint reactions.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Kinetic Energy {#kinetic-energy}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-kinetic-energy"}

**Plain Language:** The energy of motion stored in moving masses and rotating bodies.

**Technical Definition:** The quadratic form T = 0.5 * \dot{q}^T M(q) \dot{q} representing translational and rotational kinetic energy.

**Symbols / Notation:** $T$, $E_k$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## L {#l}

### Lag {#lag}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-lag"}

**Plain Language:** The angle between the lead forearm and the clubshaft during the early downswing.

**Technical Definition:** The acute wrist uncocking angle preserved during early downswing before releasing toward impact.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\theta_{wrist}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/theory-part1.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Lagrangian Mechanics {#lagrangian-mechanics}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-lagrangian-mechanics"}

**Plain Language:** A reformulation of classical physics based on energy (kinetic minus potential) rather than force vectors.

**Technical Definition:** Analytical mechanics based on the Lagrangian function L = T - V and the Euler-Lagrange equations d/dt(dL/d\dot{q}) - dL/dq = Q.

**Symbols / Notation:** $L = T - V$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Launch Angle {#launch-angle}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-launch-angle"}

**Plain Language:** The vertical angle at which the golf ball leaves the clubface relative to the ground.

**Technical Definition:** The elevation angle of the initial ball velocity vector relative to the horizontal ground plane immediately after impact separation.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\theta_{launch}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Linear Momentum {#linear-momentum}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-linear-momentum"}

**Plain Language:** The product of an object's mass and its velocity.

**Technical Definition:** The vector p = m * v representing the translational momentum of a body or system.

**Symbols / Notation:** $p$, $m v$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## M {#m}

### Magnus Effect {#magnus-effect}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-magnus-effect"}

**Plain Language:** The curving flight path caused by air pressure differences around a spinning ball.

**Technical Definition:** The transverse aerodynamic force F_M = S * (omega x v) generated on a spinning body moving through a viscous fluid.

**Symbols / Notation:** $F_M$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Moment of Inertia {#moment-of-inertia}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-moment-of-inertia"}

**Plain Language:** How difficult it is to rotate an object around a specific axis.

**Technical Definition:** The tensor I = integral( (r^T r * E - r r^T) dm ) quantifying resistance to rotational acceleration.

**Symbols / Notation:** $I$, $MOI$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Motor Program {#motor-program}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-motor-program"}

**Plain Language:** A pre-structured set of neural motor commands that execute coordinated movement.

**Technical Definition:** A stored neural representation that coordinates muscle activation timing and magnitudes without requiring continuous peripheral feedback.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/ideomotor-theory-and-predictive-brain.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Muscle Torque {#muscle-torque}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-muscle-torque"}

**Plain Language:** The rotational turning force produced across a joint by contracting muscles.

**Technical Definition:** The net moment generated by internal musculoskeletal tendon forces acting around a joint axis of rotation.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\tau_{muscle}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/theory-part2.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## N {#n}

### Null Space {#null-space}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-null-space"}

**Plain Language:** The set of internal joint adjustments that do not change the hand or clubhead position.

**Technical Definition:** The kernel of the Jacobian matrix, ker(J), containing joint velocity vectors \dot{q} that produce zero end-effector velocity J * \dot{q} = 0.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\ker(J)$, $N(J)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/null-space-constraint-jacobian.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## P {#p}

### Phase Portrait {#phase-portrait}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-phase-portrait"}

**Plain Language:** A graph showing all possible movement paths plotted as speed versus position.

**Technical Definition:** A geometric representation of dynamical system trajectories plotted in the state space (position vs velocity).

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/nonlinear-control-insights.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Potential Energy {#potential-energy}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-potential-energy"}

**Plain Language:** Energy stored due to an object's height or elastic stretching.

**Technical Definition:** The scalar function V(q) whose negative gradient produces conservative forces, F = -grad(V).

**Symbols / Notation:** $V$, $U$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Power {#power}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-power"}

**Plain Language:** The rate at which mechanical energy is transferred or work is done.

**Technical Definition:** The scalar rate of doing work, P = dW/dt = F * v + tau * omega.

**Symbols / Notation:** $P$, $\dot{W}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Pronation {#pronation}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-pronation"}

**Plain Language:** Rotating the forearm so the palm turns downward or inward.

**Technical Definition:** Rotational movement of the radius around the ulna placing the palm facing downward or posteriorly.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Protected {#protected}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-protected"}

**Plain Language:** Software branches that accept code only after automated checks and reviews pass.

**Technical Definition:** A branch management policy where direct pushes are disabled and commits require passing continuous integration gates.

[Read in Context &rarr;](overview.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Provenance {#provenance}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-provenance"}

**Plain Language:** The tracked source, version, and chain of custody for any scientific finding or dataset.

**Technical Definition:** Cryptographically verifiable metadata recording git revision, generator parameters, and input dataset hashes for published artifacts.

[Read in Context &rarr;](overview.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Proximal-to-Distal Sequence {#proximal-to-distal}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-proximal-to-distal"}

**Plain Language:** The movement pattern starting from large central body segments (hips, torso) and finishing in peripheral segments (arms, club).

**Technical Definition:** The kinetic and kinematic sequencing where proximal segment peak speeds and torques precede distal segment peaks.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## Q {#q}

### Qualified {#qualified}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-qualified"}

**Plain Language:** A research finding presented with its specific limits, assumptions, and scope attached.

**Technical Definition:** A statement whose mathematical domain, assumptions, error bounds, and unvalidated regimes are explicitly documented.

[Read in Context &rarr;](overview.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## R {#r}

### Radial Deviation {#radial-deviation}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-radial-deviation"}

**Plain Language:** Tilting the wrist towards the thumb side (wrist cocking).

**Technical Definition:** Movement of the hand at the radiocarpal joint toward the radial styloid process in the frontal plane.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Reachable Set {#reachable-set}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-reachable-set"}

**Plain Language:** All the positions and speeds a golfer can possibly reach given their strength limits.

**Technical Definition:** The set of states x(t) that can be reached from an initial state x_0 under admissible control inputs u(t) in U over horizon T.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\mathcal{R}(T, x_0)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/drift-control-ratio.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## S {#s}

### Smash Factor {#smash-factor}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-smash-factor"}

**Plain Language:** The ratio of ball speed to clubhead speed, measuring impact energy transfer efficiency.

**Technical Definition:** The dimensionless ratio v_{ball} / v_{club} measured immediately post- and pre-collision.

**Symbols / Notation:** $SF$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Spin Rate {#spin-rate}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-spin-rate"}

**Plain Language:** How fast the golf ball rotates around its spin axis right after leaving the clubface.

**Technical Definition:** The magnitude of the ball's angular velocity vector immediately following impact separation, typically reported in revolutions per minute (rpm).

**Symbols / Notation:** $\omega_{ball}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### State Space {#state-space}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-state-space"}

**Plain Language:** The complete mathematical space containing every possible combination of positions and velocities.

**Technical Definition:** The 2n-dimensional manifold or vector space x = (q, \dot{q}) representing the full instantaneous physical state.

**Symbols / Notation:** $x \in \mathbb{R}^{2n}$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Supination {#supination}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-supination"}

**Plain Language:** Rotating the forearm so the palm turns upward or forward.

**Technical Definition:** Rotational movement of the radius around the ulna placing the palm facing upward or anteriorly.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## T {#t}

### Torque {#torque}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-torque"}

**Plain Language:** A twisting or turning force that causes rotation around an axis.

**Technical Definition:** The rotational moment tau = r x F produced by a force acting at a moment arm r from a rotation center.

**Symbols / Notation:** $\tau$, $M$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## U {#u}

### Ulnar Deviation {#ulnar-deviation}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-ulnar-deviation"}

**Plain Language:** Tilting the wrist towards the little finger side (wrist uncocking/release).

**Technical Definition:** Movement of the hand at the radiocarpal joint toward the ulnar styloid process in the frontal plane.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Underactuation {#underactuation}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-underactuation"}

**Plain Language:** A condition where a system has more joints or directions of movement than available motors or muscles.

**Technical Definition:** A mechanical system having fewer independent control inputs than degrees of freedom, rank(G(x)) < dim(q).

**Symbols / Notation:** $m < n$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## V {#v}

### Vector Field {#vector-field}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-vector-field"}

**Plain Language:** An assignment of a velocity direction and speed to every point in space.

**Technical Definition:** A smooth mapping f: M -> TM assigning a tangent vector to each point on the state manifold.

**Symbols / Notation:** $f(x)$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## W {#w}

### Work {#work}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-work"}

**Plain Language:** The total mechanical energy transferred by applying a force through a distance.

**Technical Definition:** The line integral of force along a displacement path, W = integral(F * dr) = integral(tau * dtheta).

**Symbols / Notation:** $W$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Wrist Cock {#wrist-cock}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-wrist-cock"}

**Plain Language:** The hinge angle formed by radial deviation in the lead wrist during the swing.

**Technical Definition:** Frontal-plane radial deviation of the lead wrist that sets the clubshaft angle relative to the lead forearm.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

### Wrist Hinge {#wrist-hinge}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-wrist-hinge"}

**Plain Language:** The flexion/extension movement of the wrists during the swing.

**Technical Definition:** Sagittal-plane flexion and extension of the wrists, distinct from radial/ulnar deviation.

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::

## Z {#z}

### Zero-Torque Counterfactual (ZTCF) {#zero-torque-counterfactual}

::: {.glossary-entry id="def-zero-torque-counterfactual"}

**Plain Language:** The path the club and body would follow if all muscle effort ceased at a specific instant.

**Technical Definition:** The forward-simulated state trajectory under zero active control input (u=0) initialized from a declared swing state x(t_0).

**Symbols / Notation:** $ZTCF$

[Read in Context &rarr;](../articles/zero-torque-counterfactual.html){.glossary-canonical-link}

:::
